composition.ALL: Nonempty children, all alleged; all independently satisfy their row contract. No metadata-only child.
composition.ANY: Nonempty alternative allegations with complete atoms and explicit separate findings.
composition.NOT: Exactly one complete child and scoped negation; lack of evidence is not negation.
composition.QUALIFIED: Exactly one complete child, appliesToAtomId equal to that child atomId; qualifiers stay on that atom and cannot alter typed target/time/quantity values. Allowed keys epistemicPosture, sourceQuality, extentQualification; any refinement must also be explicit in atom scope.
composition.SEQUENCE: Nonempty complete children and explicit orderRelations {beforeAtomId, afterAtomId, temporalRelation}; relation BEFORE means strict end/instant < start/instant. Never infer time from array position.

logicalOutcomeAlgebra.scope: Candidate internal proposition/criterion interpretation only; mandatory domain/authority/evidence gates are always independent conjunctive obligations.
logicalOutcomeAlgebra.ALL: TRUE iff every child TRUE; FALSE if any child FALSE; otherwise INDETERMINATE.
logicalOutcomeAlgebra.ANY: TRUE if any child TRUE; FALSE iff every child FALSE; otherwise INDETERMINATE. Preserve every child finding; an OR cannot bypass a mandatory gate.
logicalOutcomeAlgebra.NOT: TRUE from an evaluated FALSE child, FALSE from TRUE, INDETERMINATE from INDETERMINATE. Missing evidence is not evaluated FALSE.
logicalOutcomeAlgebra.SEQUENCE: Conjunction of each alleged activity plus explicitly stated ordering comparisons; physical time is not inferred from array order.
logicalOutcomeAlgebra.qualification: Apply algebra only after preserving each atom’s exact scope, time, units, uncertainty and source/method meaning. No outcome confers accepted truth.

epistemic: ALLEGED, SUSPECTED, ESTIMATED and DISPUTED remain distinct qualifications. A confidence label is not probability or measurement precision unless the bound method defines it.
